_why: THE AUDITED SET IS A FIXED, REVIEWED LIST, NOT WHATEVER THE SITEMAP LANDS ON. Until 25 August 2026 the event-detail pages were discovered from the preview's sitemap and chosen as first/middle/last of the sorted slug list. That is deterministic given a FIXED sitemap and it is not deterministic at all given a changing catalogue: publish one event and 'middle' becomes a different page. On 25 August the gate landed on /events/arena-sessions-large-room-performance-test, a 1,200 seat arena chart, and scored 0.75/0.74/0.77 against a 0.80 floor while a lighter event on the same branch had passed days earlier. Nothing about the code changed between them. A gate whose subject moves is measuring the catalogue, not the branch.
_contract: Every path here is verified to answer 200 on the preview BEFORE it is audited. A path that no longer resolves FAILS THE RESOLVER LOUDLY, naming the missing path, rather than being silently replaced by another page. A silent substitution is how this gate became a coin toss; a loud failure is a five second edit to this file.
_notNarrowed: The founder's standing instruction on this gate: 'Do not narrow it to the fastest page to pass; if anything widen it.' This set keeps THREE event-detail pages and each is named for what it represents, including the heaviest page on the platform. It is pinned, not shrunk.
